{{Otheruses|Canister}}
A '''Spore/B canister''' was an ammunition type for use with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]]. It was filled with [[Spore/B]], manufactured from [[Bothan stun spore]]s. It could cause unconsciousness in the target.
